lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular passive perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: سُطِحَتْ is in the derivative form: سُطِحَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/ط/ح   s–ṭ–ḥ to be flat, flattened, to spread out, upper side. Of this root, only سُطْحَت suṭiḥat occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سُطِحَ suṭiḥa [pass. v.] to be made flat, to be flattened, to be spread out

(88:20) وَإِلَى‏ ‏الأَرْضِ‏ ‏كَيْفَ‏ ‏سُطِحَتْ‏ and [don’t they see] how the earth has been spread out?
